name: Run a focused study block
short_description: Complete a 30-minute study block with a defined question, active practice, and an end check.
self_assessment: I can complete one 30-minute study block without help and record the result.
description: Complete a 30-minute study block with a defined question, active practice, and an end check. The stated threshold defines a repeatable capability that can be demonstrated in a fresh but ordinary context. It covers preparation, execution, and checking the result within the named conditions. It excludes a one-off task or dependence on a particular product, institution, culture, or living arrangement, so the holder can assess and retain it as a transferable skill.
examples: Study one concept through retrieval practice
